resources.string: Curated palettes. The full scheme is derived from the seed with Material Color Utilities.
Pure black backgrounds in dark mode.
Springs without bounce and no ambient animation. Also on when the system removes animations.
Simple engine, also used as the automatic fallback. ASS subtitles are shown simplified, no upscaling or image options.
Default. libmpv with Nijiyome controls: full ASS subtitles, upscaling (Anime4K, FSR, Fidelity), deband and image options, all processed on the phone.
Opens mpv-android, VLC or another player with the stream and its headers.
Used when the engine is External.
No external player is installed: playback will offer Media3 instead.
Processed on the phone. Upscaling uses more battery; with automatic adjustments it turns off at 20% or less unless charging, and steps down by itself if the phone gets hot or cannot keep up.
Only the libmpv engine applies it.
Checks HTTPS sources against the phone's certificate authorities. Off by default: some servers that Media3 plays may then fail with libmpv; the player falls back to Media3.
Size of the Anime4K networks (and depth of Fidelity). High quality needs a strong GPU.
Smooths color banding in gradients (skies, dark scenes). On the phone, light.
Lowers the quality when the phone is hot, the battery is at 20% or less, or frames are dropped. You can undo it from the player.
Auto tries hardware first. HW+ uses the least battery; SW decodes anything but is slower.
mpv interpolation with display-resample. Not real frame generation.
Automatic picks the best match for your preferences and moves to the next one if it fails. Manual asks before playing.
The first source that answers wins; the others are fallbacks.
Details and episode lists. Home feeds refresh every 15 minutes.
Your watch history, with the exact position to resume, syncs with your paired PC over Nijiyome Link. No account needed.
No PC linked: history stays on this phone.
Clears settings, history, caches, extensions, the PC link and linked accounts. Cannot be undone.
Connect this app to your PC so it enhances video (Anime4K) and streams it over your local network.
Where a video starts. Mixed: your PC upscales and the phone generates the frames. You can switch it in the player.
Link a PC to process video on it. Until then everything plays on the phone.

Outbound proxy, FlareSolverr and the player's local media proxy. Changes apply to the next connection.
Every connection of the app to the internet goes through it (metadata, extensions, images, downloads, the player and the extension server). If it fails, nothing goes out directly: the request fails.
Host names are resolved by the proxy.
Torrents use the proxy only when it is SOCKS5 (peers, trackers and DHT; local discovery, UPnP and NAT-PMP are turned off). This PC and the local network (Nijiyome Link) are reached directly.
With an HTTP proxy, torrents connect directly: libtorrent can only send its traffic through a SOCKS5 proxy. Everything else uses the proxy.
Your own FlareSolverr instance. When a source answers with a Cloudflare challenge, it is solved once through it and the request is retried. Empty = off.

Streams that need cookies, credentials or Origin play through a proxy on this PC, so those headers are not sent to every server of the stream. With an outbound proxy every stream goes through it anyway.

Magnet links and .torrent files open in Nijiyome’s torrent library. Turning it off gives them back to the system only if Nijiyome still has them.
